description: Use hundreds of models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, Qwen and other vendors in GitHub Copilot Chat with one Hubris key, billed in rubles.
config.models: Model ids to show in the chat model picker, for example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`. Leave empty to show every Hubris model that can call tools. The full list is at [hubris.pw/models](https://hubris.pw/models).
config.baseUrl: Address of the Hubris API. Change it only if support asks you to.
config.showBalance: Show the Hubris balance in the status bar.
